settlement_source: The Weather Company https://weather.com/kalshi Daily Climate 'Precip (in)' relaying the NWS CLI (CF6 backup) for the station in rules_primary (CLITPA=KTPA, CLIDJT=West Palm, CLINYC=KNYC, ORD/MDW separate, IAH/HOU separate).
settlement_variable: NWS CLI 'PRECIPITATION TODAY' for the station's local calendar day; YES iff strictly > 0 i.e. >= 0.01 in. TRACE RULE RESOLVED: 'T' and missing values count as 0.00 -> NO (rules_secondary, PDF, TWC page).
timezone: Station local calendar day; close_time 05:00Z (Eastern stations) / 06:00Z (Central) the day after; Mountain/Pacific close times unverified.
tie_handling: No ties: 0.00 or T -> NO; >= 0.01 -> YES; missing -> 0 -> NO.
trading_close_vs_settlement: Opens ~09:10Z day before; closes ~local midnight after the day ends. Preliminary CLI ~4-5 PM local shows precip-so-far (not final — evening rain can flip it); final CLI ~00:30-04:30 local next day, after close. Settlement timer 1800 s.
early_close_or_void_clauses: No void. Initial non-preliminary value governs; material-error hold at Kalshi discretion; no reliable data by Expiration Date -> last fair price; missing daily value -> 0 (NO) — which applies if CLI never published is unknown; TWC 'Final' non-binding; Market Outcome Review 7.1.
title_vs_rules_divergences: 'Will it rain' includes melted snow/sleet/hail; trace rain = NO
City title vs single airport gauge (convective rain is local)
